blocks.text: 人生海海 甘需要攏了解
blocks.spelling: lîn-sing hái hái   kam su-iàu lóng liáu-kái

blocks.text: 有時仔清醒 有時青菜
blocks.spelling: ū-sî á tshing-tshínn  ū-sî tshinn-tshài

blocks.text: 有人講好 一定有人講歹
blocks.spelling: ū-lâng kóng hònn it-tīng ū lâng kóng pháinn

blocks.text: 若麥想嚇多 咱生活卡自在
blocks.spelling: ná mái siūnn hiah tsuē  lán sing-ua̍h khah tsū-tsāi

blocks.text: 歸工嫌車無夠叭 嫌厝無夠大
blocks.spelling: kui-kang hiâm tshia bô kàu pa  hiâm tshù bô kàu tuā

blocks.text: 嫌菜煮了無好吃 嫌某尚歹看
blocks.spelling: hiâm tshài tsú liáu bô hònn tsia̍h  hiâm bóo siūnn pháinn khuànn

blocks.text: 駛到好車驚人偷 大厝歹拼掃
blocks.spelling: sái tio̍h hònn tshia kiann lâng thau  tuā tshù pháinn piànn sàu

blocks.text: 吃甲尚好驚血壓高美某會兌人走
blocks.spelling: tsia̍h kah siūnn hònn kiann xiěyā gāo suí bóo ē tē lâng tsáu

blocks.text: 人生短短 好親像塊七逃
blocks.spelling: lîn-sing to to  hònn tshin-tshiūnn tè tshit tô

blocks.text: 有時仔煩惱 有時輕可
blocks.spelling: ū-sî á huân-ló  ū-sî khin-khó

blocks.text: 問我到底 腹內有啥法寶
blocks.spelling: mn̄g guá tàu-to  pak-lāi ū siánn huat-pó

blocks.text: 其實無撇步 歡喜就好
blocks.spelling: kî-si̍t bô phiat-pōo  huann-hí tio̍h hònn
